assertions.notes: After Mapa Inicial (l02) completion, the home screen showed the next pedido title without repository knowledge. Observer response: Eu abriria agora 'O que a IA faz bem e onde costuma falhar' pelo botão Atender pedido.

gaps.summary: The briefing exposes a starting hint before the learner requests one.
gaps.disposition: Review whether the starting hint should be learner-triggered; it did not require facilitator coaching or block the journey.

assertions.notes: A wrong answer produced diagnostic feedback and resettable controls. Observer response: Depois de errar, recuperacao significa entender que confianca nao substitui evidencia, identificar os criterios que faltaram e refazer a decisao; o erro nao encerra a missao.

gaps.summary: Corrective feedback names the safer answer and required criteria before retry.
gaps.disposition: Treat retry as guided application and review whether a less revealing first feedback step would improve independent discovery.

assertions.notes: Same-browser reload returned to the home screen with XP, streak, and the next pedido title preserved. Observer response: A continuidade fica neste navegador e neste armazenamento local; sem conta ou sincronizacao, ela nao acompanha automaticamente outro navegador, perfil ou dispositivo.

gaps.summary: Reload resumes at the home pedido card, not inside an in-progress lesson screen.
gaps.disposition: Document mission-level resume granularity; progress backup on the progress screen offers optional export/import for the same device.
